name: Outside the Walls
source:
The game begins as you open your eyes in an unfamiliar realm, where you must uncover the secrets of a shadowy world. But the most important question is… will you kill them, or will you save them?

[From [url=https://yigitstudio.itch.io/outside-the-walls-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏开始时，你在一个陌生的领域睁开眼睛，你必须揭开一个阴暗世界的秘密。但最重要的问题是……你会杀死他们，还是会拯救他们？

[来自[url=https://yigitstudio.itch.io/outside-the-walls-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
